title: Clockwork Mouse Realm
description: A tall ornate purple grandfather clock with a cracked face stands in a dark pixelated room, its glass case revealing a glowing green interior where anthropomorphic mice in robes interact with floating screens and each other. Above the clock, a large red eye with a blue pupil emerges from twisted black branches, while spectral blue and green mouse figures labeled 'Centuries Cycle 1996' float to the right, surrounded by game controllers and floating gears.
prompt: A surreal digital painting of a tall purple grandfather clock with a cracked face and Roman numerals, its transparent body glowing bright green and containing multiple anthropomorphic mice wearing hooded robes and interacting with floating holographic screens. A giant red eye with blue pupil emerges from black twisted branches at the top. Spectral glowing blue and green mouse spirits labeled 'Centuries Cycle 1996' float outside. Retro video game controllers and pixelated floor tiles surround the base, dark mystical atmosphere with floating gears and magical energy.
